audit_kind: Fresh goal: full current-file first pass, then alternate-route/source/invariant final pass
notation: Jackson SI units and phasor/source conventions explicitly preserved.

dimensions.mathematics_physics: All statements, subparts, intermediate equations and claimed limits retraced in the current section; see per-problem records.
dimensions.calculation_implementation: Entire current chapter script read. Independent integral/ODE/symbolic routes, domains, tolerance scales, singular endpoints and numerical convergence examined; script executed with warnings as errors.
dimensions.resources: Standalone bounded calculations and local owned output files. No persistent server, external service or process lifecycle in chapter script; solver failure assertions and exceptions propagate.
dimensions.performance: No optimization target. Finite quadrature/mesh/root limits examined for accuracy and feasibility; observed suite completed successfully. Formal universal numerical certification is not claimed.
